candidates.name: Conservative Integrator
candidates.angle: Use the existing AIOS architecture and add only the workflow pieces required now.
default_risks: May under-invest in future workflow reuse.
Can preserve awkward legacy naming too long.

candidates.name: Systems Architect
candidates.angle: Design the cleanest durable workflow boundary and persistence lifecycle.
default_risks: May introduce abstraction before multiple workflows prove the need.
Can delay the smallest shippable implementation.

candidates.name: Workflow Designer
candidates.angle: Optimize the step-by-step agent procedure and operator checkpoints.
default_risks: Can miss low-level data integrity issues.

candidates.name: Product Operator
candidates.angle: Make the workflow visible, inspectable, and useful in day-to-day operation.
default_risks: May prioritize UI before enough backend evidence exists.
Can create statuses that look more precise than they are.

candidates.name: Skeptical Minimalist
candidates.angle: Argue for the smallest inspectable version that avoids fake generic systems.
default_risks: Can reject useful exploratory evidence as premature.

candidates.name: Researcher
candidates.angle: Extract reusable patterns from prior art without copying branding or code.
default_risks: May produce broad comparisons instead of executable next steps.
Can import terminology that does not fit AIOS.

candidates.name: Chaos / Novelty Candidate
candidates.angle: Explore unusual approaches that expose hidden opportunities or failure modes.
default_risks: Can distract from the immediate implementation path.

candidates.name: Standards Enforcer
candidates.angle: Optimize around measurable criteria, verification, and documented tradeoffs.
default_risks: May favor measurable safety over novelty.
Can create too much gatekeeping for lightweight work.
